hooks.statusMessage: Checking CLAUDE.md is up to date…
hooks.command: input=$(cat); printf '%s' "$input" | grep -q '"stop_hook_active":true' && exit 0; ch=$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null); code=$(printf '%s' "$ch" | grep -E '(MobileApp|backend|scripts|docs)/|demo_dashboard\.html'); cmd=$(printf '%s' "$ch" | grep -E 'CLAUDE\.md'); if [ -n "$code" ] && [ -z "$cmd" ]; then printf '{"decision":"block","reason":"Project rule (CLAUDE.md working rule): you changed source files but did not update CLAUDE.md this session. Update CLAUDE.md to reflect what changed — new/renamed commands, routes, modules, conventions, or gotchas — then stop. If the change genuinely documents nothing new, say so in one line and stop."}'; fi; exit 0
